Name: zstudio_state
Description: Read the visible workspace, document identities, revisions and current preview.

Name: zstudio_capabilities
Description: Read all capability schemas. Unsupported formats remain read-only; MCP does not add binary patching.

Name: zstudio_open_root
Description: Open and index a ZBD root in the visible workspace. Dirty documents must be explicitly saved or closed first. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_files
Description: List recognized files in the current root.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_search
Description: Search indexed assets without altering GUI selection; names are not identities.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_related
Description: List related indexed assets for an explicit asset, retaining source identities.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_asset_filter
Description: Set the Assets list query and kind filter without changing the selected record.

Name: zstudio_open_document
Description: Open or activate an archive and its visible preview. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_assets
Description: List current edited assets by current kind/index. Resource member/script UUIDs remain stable through reordering. Offset/Length describe the edited snapshot; sourceOffset/sourceLength identify original bytes, or are null for newly added records.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_select_asset
Description: Select an asset in the GUI and await its preview; does not retarget Properties. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_inspect_asset
Description: Read original asset metadata/content and a separately frozen edited snapshot at one revision. ZRD/script inspection bounds nodes, instructions and strings. Model/world/sound lists preview 32 records; nested metadata has node/depth/text budgets with properties_truncated. Motion metadata previews up to 32 parts with 128-character names within a shared 4,096-part allowance per archive; motion_records pages all tracks. Animation inspection previews 4 records per reference table, 4 puffers and 16 sequence summaries; sequence Properties previews 8 events, event/tail raw previews use 256 bytes, and keyframe streams are omitted. Totals/truncation flags disclose omissions; animation_records/references/property_fields inspect individual records. JSON export retains complete data. Closed or changed documents reject stale results.

Name: zstudio_source_bytes
Description: Read at most 4096 original source bytes; these are not pending edits or runtime memory.

Name: zstudio_close_document
Description: Close a document. Explicit discard=true is required for unsaved edits; pending drafts are never discarded implicitly.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: discard
Parameters.Description: Explicitly discard this document's accepted unsaved edits.

Name: zstudio_reload_document
Description: Stage and reparse a clean document before replacing it, using the current model/resource Save As destination. An already-open destination, failure or pre-publication cancellation retains the document and preview. Dirty documents must first be saved or explicitly closed. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_undo_redo
Description: Undo or redo one accepted edit in the specified document.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_save_document
Description: Verified save: animations require a NEW destination outside the source root; pickup/AI/tank coordinates save owning archives or explicit new destinations; model edits save all texture variants before GameZ; ZAR/ZRD, script and texture saves verify and atomically replace each working destination or create new Save As files. Batch results preview at most 64 saved/remaining paths and 32 errors, each at most 512 characters, with SavedPathCount/SavedPathsTruncated, RemainingPathCount/RemainingPathsTruncated and ErrorCount/ErrorsTruncated. Source saves return written with writtenCount/writtenTruncated under the same path bound. All files are still saved; truncated previews are not full path identities. Global state.contentEdits reports fileCount with empty files/filesTruncated; per-document command results preview affected paths and targets. Partial content/coordinate Save As retains every requested destination; ordinary Save retries unpublished copies without overwriting existing files. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: destination
Parameters.Description: Full path of a new single-file Save As (animation, ZAR/ZRD, script or texture pack). Omit to save working files.

Parameters.Name: modelDirectory
Parameters.Description: Full path of the model Save As directory; all GameZ/texture destinations must be new. Omit for verified save to the working files.

Parameters.Name: destinations
Parameters.Description: Mission coordinate or texture batch source path to new Save As path map; cover every affected file.

AdditionalProperties.Description: New Save As full path for this source archive.

Parameters.Name: backup
Parameters.Description: Mission coordinate backup preference; defaults to app setting.

Name: zstudio_export
Description: Export assets through the existing deterministic exporter into a new folder outside the source tree. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: destination
Parameters.Description: Full path of the destination directory.

Parameters.Name: assets
Parameters.Description: Optional list of {kind,index}; omitted exports all.

Name: zstudio_validate
Description: Validate the source archive on disk, not pending edits. Returns structured diagnostics. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_problems
Description: List file/operation problems with original severity and complete source context. Long or escaped rows shorten pages; follow nextOffset.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_operation
Description: Read operation status/result. Poll at sensible intervals; cancel is available for exports, validation and world comparisons.

Parameters.Name: cancel
Parameters.Description: Request cancellation of an export, validation or world comparison.

Name: zstudio_texture_palette
Description: Read the current edited or mirrored texture header and paged RGB565 palette entries, matching the GUI palette inspector.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_preview_state
Description: Read active preview options, camera and playback state. texturePacks retains full choice names and paths on a bounded page (offset/limit, default 100, maximum 200); follow texturePackNextOffset and texturePackCount. Long or escaped paths shorten the page.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_camera
Description: Read or navigate the shared 3D camera. Supports Blender-style surface-pivot orbit, pan, continuous pointer-directed zoom with pointed-surface speed and orthographic pointer anchoring, dolly, exact axis views, perspective/orthographic projection and framing. Valid manual navigation exits animation Follow camera. Never captures physical input.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: fov
Parameters.Description: Perspective camera field of view in degrees; retained in orthographic mode.

Parameters.Name: horizontal
Parameters.Description: Mouse-equivalent delta in DIP for rotate or pan.

Parameters.Name: vertical
Parameters.Description: Mouse-equivalent delta in DIP for rotate or pan.

Parameters.Name: screenPoint
Parameters.Description: Optional [x,y] viewport DIP for rotate or zoom. Rotate picks an orbit pivot once without recentering; perspective zoom moves along the pointer ray and refreshes speed from the pointed scene surface; orthographic zoom scales about that point. Misses retain the pivot or last zoom speed. Zoom defaults to viewport center.

Parameters.Name: steps
Parameters.Description: Wheel-equivalent zoom steps; positive moves forward along the pointer ray at a speed based on the pointed surface, independently of the orbit target, or magnifies orthographic views about the pointer. Camera readback NavigationReferenceDistance retains the last surface distance or initial framing/pose fallback.

Parameters.Name: distance
Parameters.Description: Dolly displacement in game units; positive moves forward together with the target.

Parameters.Name: view
Parameters.Description: Named view for action=view; axis views are orthographic with automatic perspective on orbit.

Parameters.Name: projection
Parameters.Description: Required for action=projection; optional for set. Explicit orthographic mode persists while orbiting.

Parameters.Name: width
Parameters.Description: Orthographic view width in game units, for set or projection.

Parameters.Name: target
Parameters.Description: Frame target; defaults to asset, preserving the existing animation-only framing. Selected falls back to asset without a node selection.

Parameters.Name: node
Parameters.Description: Optional source node identity to frame, including visible descendants/runtime instances.

Name: zstudio_scene_nodes
Description: List active assembled scene nodes by index (motion previews include only the selected assembly), including instance metadata (64 JSON nodes/1024 text characters per row, inspection_truncated when shortened). Full actor/source identities are retained; long or escaped text shortens pages, so follow nextOffset. MW3 actor labels/query matching use 128-character prefixes; actor NameCharacters/NameTruncated disclose shortening. Full authored data remains available through JSON export.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_scene_selection
Description: Select/inspect a scene node with bounded metadata and inspection_truncated. Isolate includes its descendants; isolate and show_all are available only in static model/Whole world previews, matching the GUI.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: action
Parameters.Description: Selection operation; isolate/show_all require a static model or Whole world preview.

Name: zstudio_scene_options
Description: Set static model/world options: lod(integer), difficulty(Easy/Medium/Hard; RECOIL only, MW3 uses missions), textures/wireframe/bounds/horizon(boolean), texturePack(path or empty for automatic), highlight(none/nonDefaultSoils/canModify/clipTo), aiNodes/aiThroughGeometry(boolean), aiNetwork(all or ID with aiSnapshot). Highlights and AI are Whole world only. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: changes
Parameters.Description: Static model/world options. Validate the entire batch before applying changes; publish highlights and AI options only after requested refreshes succeed.

Properties.Name: aiNodes
Properties.Description: Whole world: show authored AI nodes and directed links.

Properties.Name: aiThroughGeometry
Properties.Description: Whole world: show AI through scene geometry; false enables depth occlusion.

Properties.Name: aiNetwork
Properties.Description: Whole world: all, or an AI network ID. A specific ID requires aiSnapshot.

Properties.Name: aiSnapshot
Properties.Description: Expected AI graph snapshot from preview_state.ai; required with a specific aiNetwork ID.

Properties.Name: highlight
Properties.Description: Whole world only: solid yellow non-default soils, green CanModify or red ClipTo; none restores normal appearance.

Properties.Name: lod
Properties.Description: Authored LOD rank within the active viewer's available range.

Properties.Name: texturePack
Properties.Description: Available texture pack path, or empty for automatic.

Name: zstudio_animation_options
Description: Set animation options: map/grid/collision/horizon/followCamera/effects/replay/mute/followLog(bool), height(-999..999), lod, difficulty(RECOIL only; MW3 uses missions), speed, volume, phase(runtime/cleanup), seed, condition(0/1/2), range/traceRange(seconds), autoRange/fitTrace(true), problemFilter(0..4), worldPath, root, activationOrigin/activationTarget(XYZ text or blank). Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: changes
Parameters.Description: Animation options; only supplied values change.

Properties.Name: activationOrigin
Properties.Description: Comma-separated XYZ, or blank for default.

Properties.Name: activationTarget
Properties.Description: Comma-separated XYZ, or blank for default.

Name: zstudio_animation_transport
Description: Play/pause/stop, frame-step or seek the current animation. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_animation_runtime
Description: Read preview status, sequence runtime, dispatched event occurrences, problems or bound scene nodes. Scene metadata previews retain at most 64 JSON nodes and 1024 text characters, with inspection_truncated; full metadata is available through JSON export. Identities remain complete; long rows shorten pages, so follow nextOffset. Timing thresholds and observed dispatches remain distinct.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_animation_select
Description: Select an authored sequence/event without changing playback phase or retargeting Properties.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_texture_view
Description: Inspect or set texture presentation. Channels: 0 RGBA, 1 RGB, 2 Alpha, 3 Red, 4 Green, 5 Blue. Coordinates are texture pixels.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_sound_transport
Description: Control the selected sound preview and read waveform/cue metadata.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_capture
Description: Capture the current preview or a zStudio-owned window as PNG; never captures other applications. 3D images fit within width/height without distortion or resizing the viewport. Texture/window captures keep native dimensions.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state; required for target=preview.

Name: zstudio_workspace_view
Description: Read or set presentation preferences and read effective navigatorMode (hidden, tabbed, split). Supports theme, density, preset, pane visibility/dimensions and stable section indices, including detached Files. Does not commit drafts.

Properties.Name: filesWidth
Properties.Description: Preferred detached Files width in DIP, clamped to 200–650; automatic layout does not overwrite it.

Properties.Name: inspectionPanelHeight
Properties.Description: Preferred total expanded inspection-panel height in DIP; default 432, minimum 216. Effective height is limited to 80% of the viewport without overwriting this preference; shorter viewports lower the effective minimum. Does not commit drafts.

Properties.Name: navigatorWidth
Properties.Description: Preferred dimension in DIP; clamped to supported layout limits. Navigator width is the content tabs width in split mode, or the combined tab group width otherwise.

Properties.Name: inspectorWidth
Properties.Description: Preferred dimension in DIP; clamped to supported layout limits. Navigator width is the content tabs width in split mode, or the combined tab group width otherwise.

Properties.Name: toolsHeight
Properties.Description: Preferred dimension in DIP; clamped to supported layout limits. Navigator width is the content tabs width in split mode, or the combined tab group width otherwise.

Properties.Name: navigatorTab
Properties.Description: Stable section index: 0 Files (also when detached), 1 Assets, 2 Search, 3 Document scene. Unavailable document sections are rejected.

Name: zstudio_window
Description: Read or change zStudio window state; close requires clean documents and resolved drafts.

Name: zstudio_properties_open
Description: Open the reusable Properties window for an explicit edited asset or animation sequence/event; current pending drafts must be resolved first. Model records remain pinned by identity through replacement and undo/redo. Concurrent edits reject stale loads.

Name: zstudio_properties_close
Description: Close the Properties window after drafts have been explicitly resolved.

Name: zstudio_properties_state
Description: Read the pinned Properties window identity, content and current editable fields.

Name: zstudio_scene_properties
Description: Inspect a scene node or open its Properties window, including editable mission pickups. Metadata is bounded to 512 JSON nodes/8192 text characters with inspection_truncated. MW3 actor labels use 128-character prefixes; source data and JSON exports remain intact.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_ai_networks
Description: List authored AI networks with source identities, counts and attack_strategy metadata/color (1024-character value preview). Queries match member/name/type prefixes (70 characters) or source archive before pagination. links counts resolved preview links; linkSlots counts authored slots, with linksTruncated when capped. Diagnostics preview 8 messages at 128 characters with diagnosticCount/diagnosticsTruncated. Does not simulate activation or change visualization.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_ai_nodes
Description: List authored AI nodes, XYZ, raw integer, attack_strategy and ordered link slots (three for RECOIL; MW3 preview capped at 32). link_count/links_truncated disclose full slot count and omission; inspect/export the source ZRD for all links. Network name/type previews use 256 characters with counts/truncation flags. Node queries match 70-character member/name prefixes or node_NN before pagination. Negative indices mean no link; unresolved targets retain diagnostics.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: snapshot
Parameters.Description: AI graph snapshot from preview_state.ai. Handles apply only to this snapshot.

Parameters.Name: network
Parameters.Description: Network ID, or all/omitted for all networks.

Parameters.Name: section
Parameters.Description: Spatial nodes (default) or MW3 edge constraints, which have no authored position. Constraint queries match member/name prefixes (70 characters), kind prefix (256), edge_NN, attribute_NN or node_NN endpoints before pagination. KindCharacters/KindTruncated disclose shortened kinds. Parameters is a bounded preview (64 nodes, depth 8, 2048 total text characters, 512 per string), with ParametersTruncated.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_ai_selection
Description: Select/clear an AI marker or open its pinned read-only Properties. Selection requires unlocked Whole world editing, enabled visualization and a matching filter. Read-only Properties remains available while locked. Frame a selected marker with camera action=frame,target=selected.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: snapshot
Parameters.Description: AI graph snapshot from preview_state.ai. Handles apply only to this snapshot.

Parameters.Name: node
Parameters.Description: Snapshot-scoped node ID; required except for clear.

Name: zstudio_ai_valves
Description: Page authored MW3 valve records or exact-name references from an edited resource. Includes repeated triggers, compound definitions and node/edge/objective uses; no runtime state is inferred. Query filters record names or valve references before paging. Parameters and reference previews are bounded; zrd_nodes/export retains complete data. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: member
Parameters.Description: Stable member UUID from archive_members or assets.

Parameters.Name: section
Parameters.Description: Records, references or eligible network binding targets.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_ai_valve_edit
Description: Edit one authored valve occurrence through shared resource history. set uses a scalar operand UUID and invariant typed text. add_record creates a complete action/compound block in valves.zrd; add_binding uses the owning network row's value-node UUID. Record/item moves use final zero-based pair/item positions. No implicit rename propagation or cascade deletion. Unknown fields are preserved. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: member
Parameters.Description: Stable member UUID from archive_members or assets.

Parameters.Name: record
Parameters.Description: Valve occurrence UUID except for add_record/add_binding.

Parameters.Name: operand
Parameters.Description: Scalar, action-name, union-term or target row UUID.

Parameters.Name: value
Parameters.Description: Typed set value; unquoted new valve/term name.

Parameters.Name: kind
Parameters.Description: Action, compound or binding kind from authored valve vocabulary.

Parameters.Name: index
Parameters.Description: Final item or pair index for move.

Name: zstudio_ai_valve_selection
Description: Discover mission valve resources or open one in pinned Properties without changing the Whole world preview. Uses the current AI snapshot and source member index, never names as identity. Optional record selects a discovered source occurrence. Source edits require the returned owning document's revision and stable member identity. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: snapshot
Parameters.Description: AI graph snapshot from preview_state.ai. Handles apply only to this snapshot.

Parameters.Name: archive
Parameters.Description: Exact source archive path from sources.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_scene_inspect
Description: Read independent hover/selection information from the fixed top-right inspection panel, or query an explicit viewport point/target without moving the mouse. The permanent hover readout clears its coordinates over empty space. Coordinates distinguish triangle hits, object origins and authored placement positions. AI results include attackStrategy/hoverAttackStrategy with stored value, status, key, character count, truncation and network RGB hex color. Panel state includes preferred/effective heights, viewport limits and expanded state.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: target
Parameters.Description: Opaque target from a previous inspection.

Name: zstudio_scene_card
Description: Expand/clear selected-object details below the permanent top-right hover readout, copy fields, or begin/set/apply/cancel the shared position/rotation draft. Whole world selection requires unlocked editing. Move and supported Rotate controls and handles appear only during an edit draft; unsupported Rotate stays hidden; transforms preview until apply creates one undo step. Edit actions require document/revision; set/apply/cancel require the current draft token. Copy optionally writes the clipboard.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: runtime
Parameters.Description: Optional runtime instance ID with node.

Parameters.Name: field
Parameters.Description: Copy field label; omitted copies all details.

Parameters.Name: clipboard
Parameters.Description: Write copy text to clipboard; default false.

Parameters.Name: token
Parameters.Description: Current draft lifetime and input token. Reopening a draft creates a new token.

Parameters.Name: position
Parameters.Description: Three coordinate input strings for set; maximum 64 characters each; permits temporary incomplete drafts.

Parameters.Name: rotationDegrees
Parameters.Description: Pickup XYZ Euler input strings in degrees; maximum 64 characters each.

Parameters.Name: headingDegrees
Parameters.Description: Vehicle Y heading input in degrees; maximum 64 characters.

Parameters.Name: transformMode
Parameters.Description: Draft handle mode; rotate requires supported axes.

Name: zstudio_scene_tree
Description: Read the Document scene hierarchy, including stable preview placements, shared/partition references and disconnected nodes. Read returns roots or a row's direct children, optionally filtered before paging. Expand/collapse/reveal only change tree presentation; select shares scene inspection and draft guards. Runtime parenting is not represented.

Parameters.Name: action
Parameters.Description: Tree action; default read. Properties opens the same pinned window as the row context menu.

Parameters.Name: context
Parameters.Description: Current hierarchy context from read; required for all actions and row queries.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview ID from read; required for actions on a preview hierarchy.

Parameters.Name: row
Parameters.Description: Opaque row ID for child queries or actions.

Parameters.Name: node
Parameters.Description: Scene node index for reveal/select/properties instead of row.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_animation_records
Description: List authored sequence identities; supply sequence to page its events with edited scalar fields and a 256-byte raw preview (raw_hex_truncated). Keyframe streams are omitted (keyframes_omitted); use property_fields with segment or JSON export. Event queries match these bounded displayed fields before pagination. Cleanup is listed separately from runtime sequences.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Optional sequence UUID for event details.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_references
Description: List authored reference table slots, including raw bytes and reserved/unverified status.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_event_catalog
Description: Describe supported event types, fields and preview limitations for the requested animation format version.

Name: zstudio_property_fields
Description: Read the same fields, choices, validation hints and actions as animation Properties, without opening or retargeting its window. IDs apply to this target/segment/revision.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Name: zstudio_property_edit
Description: Edit one Properties field using its current field ID and invariant editor text. Components use the delimiter shown in the current value. One undoable edit.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_property_action
Description: Run a currently available Properties action, including add/copy/delete/reorder keyframe segments.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_animation_structure
Description: Add, duplicate, delete or reorder authored sequences/events. Cleanup is not an extra runtime sequence.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_reference_edit
Description: Retarget a verified stored reference name, preserving table indices. Reserved/unverified slots remain read-only.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_pickups
Description: Load/list all authored mission pickup placements and owning archive identities, including difficulty counterparts. Full identities are retained; long or escaped paths shorten pages, so follow nextOffset. Combined query text is bounded before copying; omit query and page if that allowance is exceeded. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_pickup_lock
Description: Gate Whole world object cards, selection bounds and transform editing. Locking closes the card; unlock alone does not select an object. Source/tree inspection and hover remain available. Legacy command/state names are retained; new documents start locked. Pending drafts require explicit resolution.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: locked
Parameters.Description: Whether Whole world cards and placement edits are locked; inverse of Unlock editing.

Name: zstudio_pickup_move
Description: Move a pickup to exact coordinates as one undoable operation, including unambiguous difficulty counterparts. Requires unlocked placements.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: source
Parameters.Description: Exact source identity returned by pickups; field names are case-sensitive.

Properties.Name: ArchivePath
Properties.Description: Owning archive path returned by pickups.

Properties.Name: AssetIndex
Properties.Description: Resource asset index returned by pickups.

Properties.Name: RecordIndex
Properties.Description: Placement record index returned by pickups.

Name: zstudio_drafts
Description: Read pending GUI drafts and their conflict token without committing or changing focus.

Name: zstudio_resolve_drafts
Description: Explicitly apply or discard current GUI drafts. Invalid input is retained and returned as an error, without modal dialogs.

Name: zstudio_model_bundle_export
Description: Export all authored models under a node or an animation root as assembled and local OBJ/MTL/PNG files with stable indices, transforms and source fingerprint. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: destination
Parameters.Description: Full path of an export folder outside the source tree.

Parameters.Name: rootNode
Parameters.Description: Explicit GameZ root node, required for ambiguous animation roots.

Name: zstudio_model_replace
Description: Validate an explicit version-1 OBJ/PNG replacement manifest, then accept the entire batch as one document undo step. Model indices and source SHA-256 must match. Shared file ownership is acquired before acceptance; conflicting writers leave the document unchanged. Saves use save_document. texturePacks previews at most 64 paths of 512 characters, with texturePackCount/texturePacksTruncated; all prepared packs remain part of the edit and save. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_archive_members
Description: List edited resource members in stored order with stable identities and original source indices. Duplicate names are allowed. Standalone ZRD has one member.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_archive_edit
Description: Add, replace, rename, duplicate, delete or reorder a ZAR member as one undoable edit. add_zrd creates an empty array. Names use Latin-1 and are not identities. Move position is the final zero-based index. The active preview follows the selected member UUID; deleting or changing its content kind clears or retargets the viewer, including Undo/Redo. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: member
Parameters.Description: Required member UUID except for add/add_zrd.

Name: zstudio_resource_select

Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Description: Stable member UUID from archive_members or assets.

Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Description: Stable member UUID from archive_members or assets.

Parameters.Name: value

Parameters.Name: valves
Parameters.Description: Use the semantic MW3 valve editor; node identifies an optional valve occurrence.

Name: zstudio_motion_records

Omit part for tracks (512-character name preview, nameCharacters/nameTruncated; queries match full names); supply part for paged authored frames including the retained closing sample (query applies to tracks only). JSON export retains complete names.

Parameters.Name: member
Parameters.Description: Stable member UUID from archive_members or assets.

Parameters.Name: query

Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview

Name: zstudio_texture_targets
Description: Discover sibling texture packs with matching names. Current Save As aliases are excluded because their source records already belong to this batch. Default replacement is this pack only. Duplicate matches require explicit record indices. Names are not identities. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: query

Description: Replace a texture from RGB/RGBA PNG (16 MiB; up to 4096×4096), or add a named texture when index is omitted. Replacement dimensions must match the selected record. Explicit sibling targets retain their dimensions, using premultiplied-alpha resampling and private palettes for indexed records. One undo step owns the complete batch. Results preview at most 64 files with fileCount/filesTruncated; Path/destination keep 512 characters with PathTruncated/destinationTruncated. Each file includes at most 4 diagnostics of 256 characters with diagnosticCount/diagnosticsTruncated and MessageTruncated. All affected files remain owned and saved. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision

Parameters.Name: path

Parameters.Name: index
Parameters.Description: Texture to replace; omit to add.

Parameters.Name: name
Parameters.Description: New texture name, required when adding.

Parameters.Name: targets
Parameters.Description: Optional explicit replacement targets, including the selected record; one per sibling pack, maximum 64.

Properties.Name: path
Properties.Description: Full texture pack path, as texture_targets returns it.

Name: zstudio_script_records
Description: Page scripts in stored order, or instructions of one script. UUIDs survive edits and undo. Token previews are capped at 64 characters and 16 tokens; source offsets refer to original bytes.

Name: zstudio_script_entry_edit

Name: zstudio_script_properties

Name: zstudio_world_compare
Description: Compare two RECOIL GameZ worlds (gamez.zbd) of version 15, or 13 for the 1998 demos, such as a retail world and one rebuilt from a source project or a demo world, in the visible Compare worlds window (Tools → Compare worlds…). Their node trees are merged by parent-child structure: children match by name, then repeated names by their whole contents, then structure, their children's names and nearest position, independent of serialized node slots. After pairing, child, world-cell and overflow lists are compared in encounter order, including repeated memberships, because they can change zone selection. Pairing is one to one, each occurrence once: a node paired with several nodes of the other world (separate copies where the other shares one node or lists it twice) is changed at each of its places (counterparts), and a list naming one of its other places differs. Each pair is the same or changed (class, flags, zone, grid cell, counterparts, transform, class data, model, number of children or traversal order); other nodes are only in one world. The result gives both versions, counts them and their differences, says whether the tree is truncated (it holds at most 500,000 rows, a node under several parents appearing under each, and 256 levels), and the names several nodes share whose whole-world lookup (the engine finds a name's highest slot first) finds another node in the rebuilt world; animations bind their roots and fall back to such lookups, but search their own subtrees first, so not every one changes behaviour. Indistinguishable copies (same parents, same contents all the way down) count as the same node. The world row also reports texture-directory entry counts, load states and next-variant targets; duplicate texture names pair by directory occurrence, while distinct names may reorder. Read rows with zstudio_world_compare_tree. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: retail
Parameters.Description: Full path of the retail (expected) world file.

Parameters.Name: rebuilt
Parameters.Description: Full path of the rebuilt (actual) world file.

Name: zstudio_world_compare_tree
Description: Read the merged node tree of the Compare worlds window: its roots (the world node with its members, then the nodes no parent holds) or a row's children, optionally filtered before paging. A row is a pair of nodes or a node only one world has, with both slots, its status, how many rows below differ, whether a whole-world lookup of its name finds another node in the rebuilt world, whether the tree leaves out some of its children (truncated), and its differences (at most 16, values shortened to 256 characters and 1,024 in all, of differenceCount). selected and row also give the window's property lines for both worlds, 32 at a time of propertyCount: propertyOffset pages those of row, or of the selected row when no row is given, up to nextPropertyOffset. It only reads the comparison, so it stays available while operations run: select shows a row's properties in the window, expand and collapse change only the window's tree, and these actions return busy while a dialog is open.

Parameters.Name: context
Parameters.Description: Comparison context from zstudio_world_compare or a read; required for actions, row queries and property pages.

Parameters.Name: action
Parameters.Description: Tree action; default read. expand, collapse and select change only the Compare worlds window's presentation.

Parameters.Name: row
Parameters.Description: Opaque row ID: whose children to read, or the row to act on.

Parameters.Name: propertyOffset
Parameters.Description: Zero-based offset into the property lines of row, or of the selected row when no row is given (also the selected row's when it is row); a read returns at most 32 and nextPropertyOffset gives the next. Default 0.

Parameters.Name: differencesOnly
Parameters.Description: List only rows that differ, or hold differences below them. Independent of the window's checkbox; default false.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive text: rows whose node name, or a name below them, contains it. Independent of the window's filter.
